metadata.title: Build NO Answer Display with Probability

story.iWant: a clear, simple NO answer when rain is unlikely
story.soThat: I can confidently proceed with outdoor plans
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Extend AnswerDisplay component for NO answer logic (AC: 1) - Open existing file `components/AnswerDisplay.tsx` - Add NO answer rendering branch in component logic - Implement conditional logic: if (!willRain) render NO answer - Ensure NO answer uses same component structure as YES answer - Test both YES and NO code paths work independently - Verify TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
- Task 2: Implement NO answer header display (AC: 1) - Display location tag with glassmorphic styling above answer (reuse pattern from YES) - Format location display with 📍 emoji (e.g., "📍 San Francisco, CA") - Display "NO, it won't rain" in large, prominent text - Show probability percentage for context (e.g., "35% chance") - Use identical typography tokens as YES answer for consistency - Ensure header is responsive across mobile/tablet/desktop
- Task 3: Implement simplified layout for NO answer (AC: 1) - Display only location tag, answer text, and probability - Do NOT display rain windows, peak details, or safe windows (maintain simplicity) - Use same spacing structure as YES answer (space-y-4) - Keep visual hierarchy: Location → Answer → Probability - Apply consistent glassmorphic styling to location tag - Ensure clean, uncluttered design
- Task 4: Integrate CloseCallBadge for NO answers (AC: 1) - Reuse existing CloseCallBadge component from Story 3.4 - Add conditional rendering based on closeCall flag - Position badge after probability (same position as YES answer) - Ensure message displays: "It's a close call - consider bringing an umbrella just in case" - Verify badge appears for NO answers with 40-49% probability - Test badge does NOT appear for <40% probability
- Task 5: Ensure visual consistency with YES answer (AC: 1) - Use identical glassmorphic styling pattern for location tag - Apply same typography hierarchy (h2 for answer, text-xl for probability) - Maintain consistent spacing with space-y-4 container - Use same responsive breakpoints (sm:text-4xl, sm:text-2xl) - Verify text colors use same Tailwind tokens (text-foreground, text-muted-foreground) - Ensure both YES/NO answers feel like part of unified design
- Task 6: Test NO answer display flow (AC: 1) - Test with valid location returning NO answer (<50% probability) - Verify "NO, it won't rain" displays prominently - Verify location tag displays with 📍 emoji and glassmorphic styling - Verify probability percentage displays - Verify NO additional detail cards appear (simplicity maintained) - Test close call scenario (40-49% probability with NO answer) - Test non-close-call scenario (<40% probability) - Test responsive design on mobile, tablet, desktop - Verify TypeScript compilation (npm run type-check) - Verify ESLint validation (npm run lint)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Given the API returns a NO decision (<50% probability), When the answer is displayed, Then: - "NO, it won't rain" is prominently displayed - The location tag displays the searched location (e.g., "📍 San Francisco, CA") above the answer - The location tag uses glassmorphic styling consistent with detail cards - The probability percentage is shown for context - Close call message appears if probability is 40-49% - No additional details are shown (maintains simplicity) - The display maintains visual consistency with YES answer - The message is clear and confident - The display is responsive across all device sizes

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Simple Answer Experience
doc.section: AC-5: NO Answer Displays with Appropriate Simplicity
doc.snippet: For NO answers (probability <50%), display "NO, it won't rain" with location tag, probability percentage, and close call message if 40-49%. No additional details (rain windows, peak details) - maintain radical simplicity. Users with NO answer want quick confirmation, not data analysis.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Simple Answer Experience
doc.snippet: AnswerDisplay component renders both YES and NO answers. Conditional logic: if (willRain) render YES branch with detail cards, else render NO branch with simplified display. Location tag, probability, and CloseCallBadge shared between both branches.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Simple Answer Experience
doc.snippet: NO answer response structure: { willRain: false, probability: number, closeCall: boolean }. Rain windows, peak details, and safe windows NOT present for NO answers. Close call flag true if probability 40-49%.

doc.section: Story 3.5: Build NO Answer Display with Probability
doc.snippet: Extend AnswerDisplay component to handle NO answers with simplified display. Show location tag, NO answer text, probability percentage, and close call badge (if 40-49%). Maintain visual consistency with YES answer through identical glassmorphic styling and typography patterns.

doc.title: Story 3.4: Build YES Answer Display with Rain Details
doc.snippet: AnswerDisplay component created with YES answer branch fully implemented. Story 3.5 extends this component to add NO answer branch using if-else conditional logic. Glassmorphic styling pattern established: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 border border-white/20. Typography: text-3xl sm:text-4xl for answer, text-xl sm:text-2xl for probability.

story-context.constraints: 1. MUST extend existing AnswerDisplay.tsx file - do NOT create new file 2. MUST use if-else conditional logic: if (willRain) { YES branch } else { NO branch } 3. NO answer MUST NOT display rain windows, peak details, or safe windows (radical simplicity) 4. MUST reuse CloseCallBadge component from Story 3.4 (no modifications needed) 5. MUST use identical glassmorphic styling pattern as YES answer: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 border border-white/20 6. MUST use identical typography tokens: text-3xl sm:text-4xl for answer, text-xl sm:text-2xl for probability 7. MUST use identical spacing: space-y-4 container, same vertical rhythm as YES answer 8. MUST display location tag above answer with 📍 emoji (e.g., "📍 San Francisco, CA") 9. Close call badge MUST appear only for 40-49% probability (conditional on closeCall flag) 10. MUST maintain responsive design: same breakpoints (sm:, md:) as YES answer 11. MUST use Tailwind semantic tokens: text-foreground, text-muted-foreground (no custom colors) 12. NO new dependencies - use existing React, Next.js, Tailwind, Shadcn UI components 13. TypeScript strict mode - no 'any' types, explicit typing required 14. Testing approach: manual browser testing (no unit tests for Epic 3 - deferred to Epic 5)

tests.standards: Epic 3 testing approach: Manual browser testing on development server (http://localhost:3000). No automated unit tests (deferred to Epic 5.7 per tech spec). TypeScript compilation validation (npm run type-check), ESLint validation (npm run lint), and responsive design testing at mobile (320px), tablet (768px), desktop (1024px+) breakpoints required.
tests.locations: Manual testing on browser at http://localhost:3000 TypeScript validation: npm run type-check ESLint validation: npm run lint

ideas.test: Test NO answer with low probability (<40%): - Enter location with <40% rain probability - Verify "NO, it won't rain" displays prominently in text-3xl sm:text-4xl - Verify location tag displays with 📍 emoji and glassmorphic styling - Verify probability shows (e.g., "25% chance") in text-xl sm:text-2xl - Verify NO detail cards appear (rain windows, peak details, safe windows) - Verify close call badge does NOT appear

Test NO answer with close call (40-49%): - Enter location with 40-49% probability - Verify "NO, it won't rain" displays prominently - Verify location tag displays with 📍 emoji - Verify probability shows (e.g., "45% chance") - Verify CloseCallBadge appears with message: "It's a close call - consider bringing an umbrella just in case" - Verify NO detail cards appear

Test YES answer still works (regression test): - Enter location with ≥50% probability - Verify YES answer displays with all detail cards - Verify NO answer logic didn't break YES answer branch - Verify both code paths work independently

Test responsive design: - Open browser DevTools → Responsive mode - Test NO answer at 320px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop) - Verify text is readable without zooming - Verify no horizontal scrolling - Verify same responsive breakpoints as YES answer (sm:text-4xl, sm:text-2xl)

Test visual consistency with YES answer: - Compare YES and NO answer displays side-by-side - Verify identical glassmorphic styling on location tags - Verify identical typography (font sizes, weights, colors) - Verify identical spacing (space-y-4 container) - Verify both feel like part of unified design
TypeScript and ESLint validation: - Run: npm run type-check - Verify zero TypeScript errors - Run: npm run lint - Verify zero ESLint errors
